docs__state_backlog.description: Current app state, active paired backlog, docs policy, and durable regression-prevention notes. Keep concise; do not append repeated pass logs.
docs__state_backlog.status: Current docs policy: active backlog (`docs/dev/TODO.md`), state (`docs/dev/APP_STATE.md`), pitfall ledger, and summary bank registry are authoritative; avoid dated pass duplication.
notes: TODO entries use what/why/where/when/how, subtasks, and done criteria for active concerns only.
Pitfalls capture regressions or hidden verification gaps.
Completed work is summarized once; avoid re-adding long pass logs.

subsystem__harness_and_context.description: Run scripts, agent workflows, context-bank generation, and repo helper tooling.
subsystem__harness_and_context.status: Canonical process safety and verification context are anchored in `run.ps1`/`run.bat`, with context-bank checks and production-any boundary checks in verify. Dev preview/e2e uses build+preview, can optionally wrap RustSMF Playwright through GenEye advisory `playwright-full -Group geneye-watch-fixture`, and retains separate process-lifecycle safeguards.
notes: Use `pwsh -File run.ps1 -Task verify` for the canonical local health check; it must exit nonzero on failed gates.
Use `pwsh -File run.ps1 -Task desktop-smoke` for unbundled Tauri build, Rust peeks, and native IPC mock coverage.

Use `pwsh -File run.ps1 -Task test:e2e -GenEyeRoot <path>` when GenEye subagent evidence is useful; use `-NoGenEye` for browser-only proof. The RustSMF Playwright command remains authoritative; app evidence comes from GenEye `project_tests` plus RustSMF artifacts, while the built-in GenEye scenario is plumbing-only.
Use `pwsh -File run.ps1 -Task test:visual-strict` only for opt-in strict SMF screenshot baselines; use `test:visual-update` only for intentional snapshot refreshes.
Use no-arg `pwsh -File run.ps1` or `run.bat` for default desktop launch.
Avoid `summary_bank.json --auto-add` unless intentionally refreshing broad generated file lists; prefer narrow paths.
Temp branches are scratch only; reconcile needed work back to local main before handoff. Do not push temp branches unless explicitly named.

feature__model_loading_export.description: User-facing load, preview, edit-preview, and export flow across SMF, GLB/GLTF, FBX, and OBJ.
feature__model_loading_export.status: core connected; SMF high-fid + live pose export; dedicated Export as SMF preserves SMF-source fidelity; guarded non-SMF skinned SMF export wired and covered by generated skinned GLB e2e; true FBX-source export writes binary FBX 7500 through vendored FBXExporter-threejs and has static header + load roundtrip unit coverage; structured SMF diagnostics now preflight non-SMF SMF export, render ready/blocked state, and expose structured roundtrip check rows plus bounded worst-pose-delta details for count/geometry/bounds/animation pose in ExportPanel; static FBX fixture covers basic parser dispatch; overlapping open results guarded with stable seq refs; browser input/drop overlap has explicit e2e race coverage with delayed input read and synthetic drop read; desktop open reads binary bytes for all path-backed model formats while preserving `.smf` desktop validation first; native open/load/export overlap remains covered in mocked Tauri; SMF head-dummy hierarchy walk is cycle-safe for self-parent root heads, inverse binds refresh world matrices before calculateInverses, and animation tracks skip non-scene heads so real .smf load clears without missing-target warnings; source-format detection is centralized in `source/frontend/src/utils/modelFormat.ts` with explicit unsupported-format fail-fast behavior; loader clips contract is direct; tauri client is cached; Tauri env/path casts, load/export error catches, and GLB/FBX skinned traversal are typed; `check-production-any.mjs` prevents broad production any casts from returning.

feature__smf_export_diagnostics.description: Structured SMF export preflight for non-SMF skinned sources plus compact Export workspace diagnostics.
feature__smf_export_diagnostics.status: implemented for structured compatibility checks, report saving, and material/texture warnings: missing skeleton and scale tracks block export; missing UVs/normals warn; missing skinIndex/skinWeight blocks skinned export; non-POT textures, multiple material slots, and multiple texture maps warn without blocking GLB fidelity export; ExportPanel shows texture map type/name/mesh/material slot/resolution/source/POT status; in-memory roundtrip reports now include status plus check rows/codes for counts, geometry, bounds, animation timing/metadata, first/last-frame pose, and bounded worst-pose-delta details with animation/frame/bone parent/isBone/component deltas; generated skinned GLB smoke asserts ready diagnostics, texture summary rows, and pass checks, static OBJ smoke asserts blocked diagnostics, and report JSON serialization is unit-covered.
next_steps: Decide whether richer material layouts should remain warning-only, block SMF export, or offer a split/export action.
Add a compact texture/material detail panel only if the Export cockpit list becomes too dense.

feature__modern_editor_workspaces.description: Modern editor shell inspired by old-src GameMaker screenshots: mode-specific workspaces, active single/quad viewport layout, model-safe wireframe display, large bone handles/labels, clear skinning state, and GLB-first authoring with SMF backwards compatibility.
feature__modern_editor_workspaces.status: Editor workspace shell and quad/shared layout are active; constrained-width mode tabs now use a scrollable row and deterministic post-load smoke coverage; the top toolbar is grouped into file, workspace, layout/camera, editor history, and compact Display-menu controls; quad view has pane dividers/labels plus e2e overlay assertions; single-view Ortho framing and Display menu visuals are covered by smoke/visual tests. Skin-weight edit helpers, typed dirty-state model, selected-bone set/add/subtract/Auto Paint viewport paint, brush telemetry, empty-space miss no-op behavior, skinned-world brush candidate indexing, vertex/triangle brush targets, toolbar/keyboard undo-redo checkpoints, full-model Normalize, precise typed Auto Skin algorithm/options controls with legacy id normalization, continuity checks, and supported SMF dirty-export serialization are active. Rig mode now has validation report rows plus non-SMF selected-bone rename with animation-track/authored-key retargeting, selected-bone reparent with cycle validation/world-transform preservation, selected-bone create-child with Skeleton inverse/buffer initialization, selected-bone delete with weighted-skin-reference guards plus index/animation cleanup, and toolbar/keyboard undo-redo snapshots for those rig edits. Outliner submodel visibility/color cues, multi-select/bulk visibility actions with toolbar/keyboard undo-redo, shared chronological Undo/Redo routing across editor/Skin/Outliner stacks, View-mode model/submodel picking synced to Outliner selection, viewport-only selected-object overlays, imported/authored timeline keyframe markers, selected-bone keyframe edit state plus toolbar/keyboard key-edit undo-redo, explicit viewport pointer-owner routing, TransformControls owner telemetry, Animate-owned viewport transform key authoring, pose Undo/Redo toolbar/keyboard history for nudges/gizmo/endpoint edits, Insert/Update/Delete/Copy/Paste animation controls, structured Export cockpit roundtrip check rows, viewport-only Legacy SMF-lit display material clones, and Skin pts skinned vertex overlays are active. Remaining old-editor parity is deeper animation clip polish, SMF head-node-aware metadata edits, rig detach/connect and mirror/reset helpers, real-SMF strict pose roundtrip cleanup, direct browser-level TransformControls handle-drag automation, and deeper precision controls while preserving shared model root continuity.
requirements: Default to a polished single perspective viewport, with optional quad view and model-safe wireframe display for rigging/skinning precision.
Rig and skin modes need larger screen-space bone glyphs, labels, endpoint handles, hover/selected states, and adjustable hit radius.
Mode tabs should expose Model, Rig, Skin, Animate, and Export workflows without recreating GameMaker chrome.
GLB/GLTF remains the preferred modern fidelity path; SMF remains a compatibility format with explicit limits.

workflow__old_editor_parity_source_map.description: Focused old GameMaker reference map for adapting RustSMF workspaces, display toggles, skin paint, animation keyframes, and viewport precision behavior without recreating old chrome verbatim.
workflow__old_editor_parity_source_map.status: active backlog; current RustSMF has single/quad layout, single-view Ortho, pane labels/dividers, grouped Display-menu controls, model-safe wireframe display, explicit viewport pointer-owner routing, separate TransformControls owner telemetry, Legacy SMF-lit viewport display materials, Skin pts skinned vertex overlays, selected-object viewport overlays, Outliner submodel visibility/color cues plus multi-select/bulk visibility and undo-redo, View-mode model/submodel picking, endpoint handles, Rig validation/rename/reparent/create/delete with toolbar/keyboard undo-redo for non-SMF sources, skin paint/Auto Paint/Normalize/Auto Skin toolbar undo-redo checkpoints, empty-space skin paint miss safety, skinned-world brush candidate indexing, precise autoskin algorithm ids plus legacy normalization, pose Undo/Redo for nudges/gizmo/endpoint edits, Animate-owned viewport transform key authoring, autoskin algorithm/options plus normalize batch tools, imported/authored timeline keyframe markers, selected-bone animation keyframe authoring with toolbar/keyboard undo-redo, structured Export cockpit checks, and playback/pose-edit affordances. Remaining mapped work is deeper animation clip polish, direct browser-level TransformControls handle-drag automation, SMF head-node-aware rig metadata edits, rig detach/connect and mirror/reset helpers, real-SMF strict pose roundtrip cleanup, and deeper ortho-pane interaction parity.
notes: Keep display-only toggles separate from data-mutating commands.
Use old scripts/screenshots to identify behavior and constraints, not to duplicate the GameMaker UI frame one-for-one.

subsystem__viewport_editor.description: Three.js viewport, orbit controls, model attach/dispose, animation mixer, modern skeleton helper, raycast/helper-hit bone selection, TransformControls, model-safe wireframe display, and weight preview/edit helper boundaries.
subsystem__viewport_editor.status: modular and typechecked; Inspector bone tree typed and tracks hierarchy expansion by bone UUID so rename does not collapse expanded rows; Rig panel validates skeleton graph and skin references, can rename selected non-SMF bones while retargeting animation tracks/edits, can reparent selected non-SMF bones with cycle validation plus world-transform preservation, can create child bones with Skeleton inverse/buffer initialization, and can delete unweighted non-root branches with Skeleton compaction, skinIndex remapping, animation track/edit cleanup, and pose cleanup; viewport drag filtering, context-aware R reset vs TransformControls mode shortcuts, ref-decoupled timing, typed TransformControls drag events, typed disposal helpers, and bonePicker remain current. Labels are toggleable per-bone via extracted boneLabels.ts + useBoneLabels hook. Endpoint-like marker handles, precision hover marker, hover dataset telemetry, endpoint drag constraints, viewport-only selected-object overlays, and a render-only wireframe override do not mutate export materials. `viewportInteractionRouter.ts` now decides pointer owners before mutation and feeds canvas telemetry for model-select, rig-select, rig-endpoint-drag, skin-paint, animate-select, orbit, and read-only/no-op paths; TransformControls ownership is reported separately through transform owner/attached/dragging telemetry. View-mode model-select now raycasts visible Mesh/SkinnedMesh objects into Outliner selection, supports empty-click clear plus context-readiness status, shares Shift/Ctrl selection semantics with Outliner rows, and rebuilds selection overlays when selected object visibility changes. TransformControls are disabled in View/Export, pose-owned in Rig/Skin, and animation-owned in Animate; Animate-owned transform events upsert selected-bone keyframes at the current timeline time instead of marking pose edits. TransformControls/endpoint pose events still mark pose edits for export and push pose history snapshots for toolbar/keyboard Undo/Redo. The modern skeleton helper draws larger diamond spans and joint markers with bone metadata for direct helper-hit selection, then falls back to distance picking. Quad mode has explicit pane dividers/labels and per-pane clearing; single-view Ortho gets active-canvas frustum sizing; endpoint drag, wireframe/display state, visible quad-overlay, and loaded Display-menu/Ortho verification are exercised in smoke/visual tests. Weight preview uses the same typed four-slot skin-weight reader as the edit helper model; skin paint strokes bracket touched-vertex snapshots for undo/redo; empty paint misses leave the brush inactive and do not dirty skin state; Auto Paint and full-model Normalize/Auto Skin algorithm/options actions use precise canonical ids, keep legacy ids normalized, and use the same undo/dirty/export path. `skinBrushIndex.ts` supports local and skinned-world candidate indexes; active viewport painting uses skinned-world indexing before radius/depth checks.
notes: updateHighlightPosition extracted for RAF use in viewport (modularity + testability); labels canvas polish (DPR scale, textBaseline, truncation for quality/readability). 2026-06-18: viewport pane math and guard logic moved to utils/viewportLayout.ts; unit coverage added in viewportLayout.test.ts.
edge_cases: Overlapping loads must not overwrite newer state.
TransformControls drag must not also orbit the camera.
Unmount/remount must not leak window or canvas listeners.

subsystem__smf_format_and_fidelity.description: SMF binary parsing/export, coordinate swizzles, dual-quaternion math, roundtrip fidelity, and old reference format material. Internal binary helpers (bytes + bounded R/W) live in smfBinary.ts (shared, barrel exposes bytesToArrayBuffer plus BinaryReader/BinaryWriter).
subsystem__smf_format_and_fidelity.status: SMF source roundtrip and visual coherence verified; SMF loader treats rig DQs as world bind transforms with true inverse binds and local animation tracks; SMF export guards zero-duration animation normalized times and invalid DQ normalization now falls back to identity for zero/NaN/Infinity rotation parts; non-SMF exact SMF export wired and covered by generated skinned GLB e2e; smfBinary canonical; smfRig preserves explicit SMF head nodes for export and provides buildRigHierarchy for Three: skips heads on attach/skel with cycle-safe effective is-bone ancestor lookup, updates world matrices before inverse binds, and keeps animation tracks on real scene bones only; constructed lists stay direct; names SMF_Node for roundtrips
notes: SMF animation count is u8 at ANIM offset.
SMF source export uses loaded ImportedSmf data and applies live position/rotation pose edits before export.
Loaded SMF visual checks should compare against old-src screenshots and CPU bind-pose skinning invariants, not just parser success.

subsystem__tauri_bridge_and_rust_peeks.description: Tauri native dialog/save/read commands, browser fallbacks, Rust SMF header/section peeks, and desktop status messages.
subsystem__tauri_bridge_and_rust_peeks.status: native peeks and fallback strings covered; Rust SMF header/section parsing is extracted to `source/src-tauri/src/smf_core.rs` with typed `SmfHeaderSummary`/`SmfDesktopInfo` and tests for valid fixtures, bad versions, missing null terminators, invalid offsets, and count widths; `TauriClient` contract is centralized in `source/frontend/src/backend-client/tauri.ts`; `useLoadModel.ts` uses typed bridge and loader contracts for fewer runtime/typing mismatches; Playwright native IPC mock spec covers open/read/save/write/cancel and now asserts delayed-write single-flight export overlap plus `get_smf_desktop_info` argument + status-contract checks, and non-SMF native path loads are now explicitly exercised via `read_file_binary`; true OS-dialog automation is deferred until a dialog-only bug, CI requirement, or release checklist needs it
open_items: Evaluate tauri-driver or equivalent only if true OS-dialog open/save roundtrips become necessary.
Keep Rust, TS loader, and Playwright desktop simulation aligned for parser widths and offsets.

subsystem__dev_process_lifecycle.description: Launcher (run.ps1/run.bat), beforeDev wrapper (start-vite-dev.mjs for tauri dev server), Tauri conf, process safety (Job objects, recursive tree kills, parent-pid poll, port+cmdline stale sweeps, signals/finally/traps), and related dev server lifetime (playwright preview separate).
subsystem__dev_process_lifecycle.status: 2026-06-16: layered Windows safety implemented + clean (New-KillOnCloseJob for X-close even if finally skipped; Start-Process ownership + finally for dev/tauri-dev; Stop-ProcessTree + Stop-DevServers (5173 node + 'vite|start-vite-dev|tauri' cmdline) + Stop-Stale on entry; trap + PowerShell.Exiting; mjs wrapper for beforeDev with SIGS/'exit'/killViteTree/taskkill /T + win32 parent poll + delay). tauri.conf beforeDev still points at mjs. 2026-06-18 added unix fallback handling in wrapper (`pkill`/`kill`) and kept direct-launch caveat docs explicit. Green on cargo/context/typechecks/verify.
notes: Primary coverage for close-cmd-window (Job), close-tauri-app (mjs poll+tree), Ctrl+C, next-launch-clean (stale entry sweeps). Redundant layers on Win. See issue__rogue_node_servers and issue__launcher_contract_matrix.
Playwright webServer uses preview (playwright-managed, reuse:false); separate from persistent dev server.

issue__launcher_contract_matrix.description: The default launcher behavior and process-safety guarantees differ between Windows menu flow and direct/non-Windows launch flows, which can cause onboarding ambiguity.
issue__launcher_contract_matrix.current_solution: Windows-protected launcher path is canonical and documented; README/docs/user/APP_STATE now carry the matrix, and run.ps1 help contains explicit direct-launch caveats. No broader launcher rework has been promoted yet.
issue__launcher_contract_matrix.next_prevention: Keep contract statements aligned across README/docs/user/APP_STATE and verify no stale mention of outdated launcher guarantees appears during future doc edits.

issue__geneye_precheck_without_evidence.description: A standalone GenEye smoke precheck can prove GenEye health without producing RustSMF Playwright JSON, artifact, or subagent-handoff evidence for the actual e2e run.
issue__geneye_precheck_without_evidence.current_solution: `run.ps1 -Task test:e2e` resolves optional GenEye and passes RustSMF's own `npm run test:e2e -- --reporter=json` command to GenEye `playwright-full -AllowGenEyeFailure -Group geneye-watch-fixture`, writing ignored evidence under `runtime-data/geneye-playwright-runs`. `-NoGenEye` or `RUSTSMF_NO_GENEYE=1` forces browser-only proof. Missing GenEye or pre-evidence GenEye failure falls back to browser-only Playwright; project-test failures still exit nonzero.
issue__geneye_precheck_without_evidence.next_prevention: When GenEye `playwright-full` or RustSMF e2e command names change, update README/tests/APP_STATE/pitfall text together and re-run the GenEye-backed path plus browser-only fallback.

issue__rogue_node_servers.description: Rogue node/vite (or tauri-cli) dev servers left listening after close cmd/pwsh window (X), close Tauri app, Ctrl+C, or hard kill when using tauri dev (beforeDevCommand spawn) or direct npm/vite.
issue__rogue_node_servers.status: fixed 2026-06-16 via layered launcher (run.ps1 Job+tree+scans+finally+trap+stale) + beforeDev wrapper (mjs signals+killViteTree+taskkill /T+parent poll). Prior related: issue__launcher_default_local_tauri. Status includes unix fallback in wrapper (`pkill`/`kill`) for non-Windows environments. Checks (typecheck/cargo/context/verify) clean post-implementation.
issue__rogue_node_servers.current_solution: Stop-StaleDevStack (port 5173 node + cmdline sweeps) on dev entry + finally/trap; New-KillOnCloseJob (auto child add); recursive Stop-ProcessTree; mjs killViteTree (SIGTERM + win taskkill /T + parent poll every ~1.8s + exit handler). Tauri CLI term of beforeDev child triggers mjs. Entry sweep prevents 'port in use' on re-launch.
issue__rogue_node_servers.next_prevention: Keep direct non-canonical launch paths documented as reduced-coverage, and re-run manual close/relaunch checks after any launcher or script-layer edits.

tests__quality.description: Automated quality gates: lint, app typecheck, test typecheck, production any boundary check, Vite build, chunk guard, unit roundtrips, Playwright e2e, native IPC mocks, and Rust cargo checks/tests.
tests__quality.status: Quality posture: app/typecheck gates, production any boundary checks, unit and e2e suites, native IPC/preview checks, editor history push/pop/limit/order and viewport interaction router unit coverage, animation edit snapshot/history coverage, View-mode model-picking, Outliner bulk-action/visibility-history, cross-domain editor/Skin/Outliner chronological undo smoke coverage, Skin toolbar history, rig edit toolbar undo-redo smoke coverage, animation key toolbar/keyboard undo-redo smoke coverage, and Skin Auto Weight option smoke coverage, optional GenEye advisory e2e evidence, and chunk/verify gates are the canonical verification baseline; visual strict checks are opt-in.

issue__docs_context_path_drift.description: Backlog/docs moved under docs/dev while README, run.ps1, tests README, agent instructions, tool notes, and summary_bank.json still referenced deleted docs/TODO.md or nonexistent plan.md.
issue__docs_context_path_drift.status: fixed 2026-06-15; docs are indexed, active backlog path is docs/dev/TODO.md, research inbox policy is explicit, local agent/tool instructions point at current durable docs, and verify runs a context-bank path guard
issue__docs_context_path_drift.current_solution: Current docs point at docs/dev/TODO.md; historical pitfall text can still mention old docs/TODO.md as a past failure. The verifier fails stale explicit summary-bank paths and missing glob prefixes.
issue__docs_context_path_drift.next_prevention: Run `python scripts/verify-context-bank.py` after doc moves and keep active docs in docs/dev rather than adding new progress files.

issue__test_wrapper_false_success.description: PowerShell npm wrapper leaked command output into a boolean return, allowing run.ps1 test:e2e to print npm failure while returning exit code 0.
issue__test_wrapper_false_success.status: fixed 2026-06-14; wrapper output is written to host and test:e2e exits nonzero on failed npm status
issue__test_wrapper_false_success.current_solution: Invoke-FrontendNpm captures LASTEXITCODE after writing npm output to host; test:e2e branches on the boolean return and exits 1 on failure.
issue__test_wrapper_false_success.next_prevention: For new native-command wrappers, validate both passing and failing exit-code behavior.

issue__module_scope_react_hook_boot_cras.description: A React hook used as a module-scope cache caused the production app to fail before the shell mounted.
issue__module_scope_react_hook_boot_cras.status: fixed 2026-06-18; Tauri client cache now uses a plain module variable, React/Vite dedupe is hardened, and browser plus GenEye-backed e2e pass
issue__module_scope_react_hook_boot_cras.current_solution: React hooks stay inside components/custom hooks; module-level lazy caches use plain variables or functions. Full e2e catches blank-page boot regressions that build/typecheck cannot catch.
issue__module_scope_react_hook_boot_cras.next_prevention: Search for module-scope `use*` calls during hook/cache refactors and rerun at least the app-boot smoke before broader e2e.

issue__typecheck_gap.description: ESLint ignored TS/TSX and Vite did not typecheck, allowing app type drift despite green verify.
issue__typecheck_gap.status: fixed for app source on 2026-06-13; test-source gate restored on 2026-06-14; verify now runs both
issue__typecheck_gap.current_solution: Run app `typecheck` and `typecheck:test`; both are included in `run.ps1 -Task verify` and `source/package.json` verify.
issue__typecheck_gap.next_prevention: Keep app and test tsconfigs separate; do not mark a type gate done without running it.

issue__doc_coverage_overclaim.description: Progress docs claimed test-source typecheck/native IPC coverage and some fixture coverage that was not present in the repo.
issue__doc_coverage_overclaim.status: fixed for typecheck/native IPC on 2026-06-14; default skinned non-SMF fixture gap fixed on 2026-06-15 with generated skinned GLB coverage
issue__doc_coverage_overclaim.current_solution: Docs are concise current-state/backlog docs; missing gates were added and runnable; generated skinned GLB e2e covers non-SMF skinned load/export without external asset assumptions.
issue__doc_coverage_overclaim.next_prevention: Before marking coverage complete, verify referenced files exist and run the documented command.

issue__skinned_fixture_skip.description: Full non-SMF skinned load/export e2e depended on an absent local FBX sample and skipped by default.
issue__skinned_fixture_skip.status: fixed 2026-06-15; generated self-authored skinned GLB fixture covers load, bone select, guarded SMF export, GLB export, screenshot, and console cleanliness
issue__skinned_fixture_skip.current_solution: Generate a tiny two-bone animated GLB in Playwright's Node context and pass it to the hidden file input as `generated-skinned-fixture.glb`.
issue__skinned_fixture_skip.next_prevention: Prefer generated or committed self-authored fixtures over machine-local optional fixture paths for required e2e coverage.

issue__launcher_default_local_tauri.description: Default project launcher path did not reliably start the app: run.ps1 showed help by default, run.bat assumed pwsh, and Tauri CLI lookup could depend on globals.
issue__launcher_default_local_tauri.status: fixed 2026-06-15; no-arg run.ps1/run.bat launch desktop dev and route through local npm Tauri CLI
issue__launcher_default_local_tauri.current_solution: Default Task is tauri-dev, run.bat falls back to Windows PowerShell, and Tauri commands execute via local npm workspace scripts.
issue__launcher_default_local_tauri.next_prevention: After run-script edits, execute the exact no-arg launchers in addition to verify.

issue__vite8_e2e_preview_server.description: Vite 8 dev-server HMR websocket failures could reset Playwright pages during parallel WebGL/file-flow tests and appear as app regressions.
issue__vite8_e2e_preview_server.status: fixed 2026-06-15; Playwright e2e builds first and serves production preview with local workers capped
issue__vite8_e2e_preview_server.current_solution: webServer command is `npm run build && npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort`; reuseExistingServer is false and local workers are capped at 4.
issue__vite8_e2e_preview_server.next_prevention: Keep e2e on production preview unless a replacement passes the full suite without websocket/page-reset symptoms.

issue__chunk_guard_false_success.description: Entry chunk guard warned and exited 0 when the expected three-vendor split or dist output was missing.
issue__chunk_guard_false_success.status: fixed 2026-06-15; guard exits nonzero on missing build output or missing vendor split
issue__chunk_guard_false_success.current_solution: check-entry-chunks logs errors and exits 1 for missing dist or missing `three-vendor`.
issue__chunk_guard_false_success.next_prevention: Keep guard scripts fail-closed unless skipped output is explicitly part of the command contract.

issue__open_dialog_stale_result.description: Older openFile dialog results or browser file/drop read failures could mutate status/error or call loadModel after a newer operation had started.
issue__open_dialog_stale_result.status: completed 2026-06-18; handleOpen uses openSeqRef and browser file/drop read success/catch paths use fileReadSeqRef before mutation.
issue__open_dialog_stale_result.current_solution: handleOpen increments `openSeqRef`; browser file-input/drop reads increment `fileReadSeqRef`; stale success/catch paths return before state mutation. Native overlap checks stay in `native.spec.ts`; browser overlap checks added with delayed input reads + synthetic drop reads in `smoke.spec.ts`.
issue__open_dialog_stale_result.next_prevention: Keep overlap checks current if `open`/load orchestration changes or if browser export-save mockability becomes deterministic enough for parity checks.

issue__desktop_open_non_smf_path_read.description: Desktop path-based opens for non-SMF formats could be under-specified, with only SMF-specific validation path covered and no explicit assertion that non-SMF branches read file bytes through the desktop bridge.
issue__desktop_open_non_smf_path_read.current_solution: Native open now always reads bytes with `readBinaryFile` when `res.path` is present for non-SMF formats, while preserving SMF header peek for `.smf`; `native.spec.ts` now includes a path-backed non-SMF open test (`.obj`) that asserts `read_file_binary` is called and `get_smf_desktop_info` is intentionally not used.
issue__desktop_open_non_smf_path_read.next_prevention: Keep format-agnostic desktop path-load coverage in `native.spec.ts` whenever a new supported import format is added.

issue__smf_visual_tearing.description: Real SMF sample loaded without console errors but rendered as torn mesh wedges because SMF world bind DQs/frame poses were treated as local transforms and raw byte weights were not normalized for Three skinning.
issue__smf_visual_tearing.status: fixed locally 2026-06-15; CPU bind-pose skinning regression added and visual screenshots show coherent low-poly character
issue__smf_visual_tearing.current_solution: Derive local bone transforms from stored SMF world bind matrices, compute true inverse bind matrices, convert animation frame world poses to local parent tracks, and normalize skin weights for Three rendering while preserving imported SMF export data.
issue__smf_visual_tearing.next_prevention: Keep the real-sample bind-pose skinning regression and visual check around any SMF rig/animation changes.

issue__smf_head_parent_load_hang.description: Real SMF files can use self-parented isBone=0 head dummies; an unguarded head-skip walk can spin during buildThreeScene and leave the UI loading indefinitely.
issue__smf_head_parent_load_hang.status: fixed 2026-06-16; effective-parent lookup tracks visited nodes, inverse binds calculate after world-matrix refresh, animation tracks target real scene bones only, app typecheck restored, real SMF smoke/native/browser checks passed
issue__smf_head_parent_load_hang.current_solution: Use `findEffectiveBoneParentIndex` for hierarchy and animation local-parent resolution; keep seq guards stable with refs; verify with unit, targeted SMF Playwright, native IPC mock, Browser shell, and full `verify`.
issue__smf_head_parent_load_hang.next_prevention: Before changing SMF parent walking or animation track targeting, run the root-head unit slice and targeted real SMF Playwright load.

issue__stale_strict_visual_baselines.description: Optional strict SMF screenshots can stay stale after renderer fixes, and tracked Playwright report/test-result artifacts can dirty source after each run.
issue__stale_strict_visual_baselines.status: fixed locally 2026-06-15; strict SMF snapshot check/update tasks added, coherent SMF load/export baselines regenerated, and generated report/result files removed from tracking
issue__stale_strict_visual_baselines.current_solution: `test:visual-strict` runs the key SMF strict snapshot subset with RUSTSMF_STRICT_VISUALS=1; `test:visual-update` refreshes baselines intentionally; generated `playwright-report/` and `test-results/` files are ignored and untracked.
issue__stale_strict_visual_baselines.next_prevention: When renderer or bone-overlay work changes the intended viewport, run strict visual checks and inspect the PNGs before committing.

issue__branch_work_reconciliation.description: Execute-plan refs and the local auto-stash contained different useful work that was not represented on main.
issue__branch_work_reconciliation.status: fixed locally 2026-06-15; execute-plan old-src docs/screenshots/proof artifacts and reddit option metadata restored, old-src GML/YY/SMF.yyp source metadata recovered from stash@{0} with whitespace-only cleanup where needed, old-src GameMaker state user-tested after recovery, SMF export/test fixes ported, and local temp branches cleaned after verification
issue__branch_work_reconciliation.current_solution: Work locally on main, restore/port needed temp-branch or stash work into main, inspect stashes before cleanup, user-test old-src GameMaker recovery when GML changes are involved, and only push main when explicitly requested.
issue__branch_work_reconciliation.next_prevention: Before deleting local temp branches or stash entries, compare branch diffs, run `git stash show --name-status`, and confirm unique work is represented locally or intentionally archived.

issue__desktop_smf_parser_width.description: Playwright desktop SMF info simulation read animation count as u32 while runtime parser uses u8.
issue__desktop_smf_parser_width.status: fixed on 2026-06-13; 2026-06-14 full review: still aligned (Rust u8 + TS loader + sim + cargo test fixture)
issue__desktop_smf_parser_width.current_solution: JS simulation now reads `bytes[p.offAnim]` as u8 and Rust fixture keeps the width locked.

issue__smf_binary_edge_cases.description: Malformed or edge-case SMF data can produce opaque parser failures or non-finite export values if binary reads, DQ normalization, and animation time normalization are not guarded.
issue__smf_binary_edge_cases.status: current guard coverage: bounded reads throw actionable errors, invalid DQs normalize safely, zero-duration animation export writes finite normalized time 0, and unit regressions cover those paths
issue__smf_binary_edge_cases.current_solution: Use shared BinaryReader/BinaryWriter bounds checks, safe DQ normalization, and guarded normalized animation frame times.
issue__smf_binary_edge_cases.next_prevention: Keep malformed-input and zero/invalid transform unit tests near any SMF parser/export helper changes.

issue__incomplete_binary_dedupe.description: After 'BinaryReader bounds' / threeToSmf / poseEdits integrity changes, smfBinary.ts existed (with improved ensure/patch + bytesTo) but was untracked + not imported; smf.ts, useLoadModel.ts and tauri.ts retained full/partial duplicate bytesTo + (smf) entire old Binary* classes. Barrel did not surface the util. Docs over-claimed the dedupes.
issue__incomplete_binary_dedupe.status: completed: binary helper ownership and import/export dedupe are centralized with grep-verified single-owner checks and tests.
issue__incomplete_binary_dedupe.current_solution: smfBinary is now the canonical owner, and bytesToArrayBuffer + BinaryReader/BinaryWriter are re-exported from loader index. Consumers use the shared API; bounds checks are active on export too. saveFile bool is fixed in the same sweep.
issue__incomplete_binary_dedupe.next_prevention: On any refactor that moves helpers (esp. between loaders/* and bridges), immediately update all direct consumers + barrel + run full typecheck + grep for duplicate fn/class names. Treat untracked critical src files as P0 during review.

subsystem__modularity_candidates.description: High-line-count files that should be split only at safe, test-backed boundaries. smfBinary.ts is the focused home for binary (after dedupe).
subsystem__modularity_candidates.status: watch; 2026-06-18 rank: ThreeViewport.tsx(930), smoke.spec.ts(619), coord.test.ts(618), smf.ts(507), useLoadModel.ts(469), main.rs(433). Pure quad/ortho pane math was extracted to utils/viewportLayout.ts; keep future camera/layout helpers out of ThreeViewport unless tightly coupled to live render state.

issue__inspector_clip_duration_and_type_.description: Inspector clip duration displayed literal `${}` text (JSX text vs expression bug). Related type safety gaps: findBoneByName returned any, lastSmfDataRef typed as any, onNudgeBone delta type was inline duplicate, isScaleEdit was dead-code stub.
issue__inspector_clip_duration_and_type_.current_solution: Clip duration uses JSX expression `{(c.duration).toFixed(2)}`. findBoneByName returns THREE.Bone | undefined. lastSmfDataRef typed as ImportedSmf | null. Inspector imports BoneNudgeDelta. Bone highlight group disposed via disposeThreeObject. isScaleEdit removed. Focus cancel debounce raised to 150ms. tsconfig uses ignoreDeprecations.
issue__inspector_clip_duration_and_type_.next_prevention: In JSX text nodes, always wrap dynamic values in {}. Return concrete types from shared helpers. Prefer imported shared types over inline duplicates.

issue__mode_layout_transition_continuity.description: Mode or viewport-layout switches could alter selected-bone/clip scrub state without explicit continuity checks, even when model/model-root state was preserved.
issue__mode_layout_transition_continuity.status: partially complete: smoke checks cover continuity across normal, medium, and constrained-width viewports; remaining work is a broader dedicated transition suite around export/status timing and negative no-model panel writes.
issue__mode_layout_transition_continuity.current_solution: Mode/layout transition semantics are covered in smoke tests with continuity assertions around `Selected` and scrub values; pre-load no-model path now forces single layout by design and keeps layout toggles disabled until a model exists.
issue__mode_layout_transition_continuity.next_prevention: Keep these continuity assertions with any future workspace/viewport refactor that moves layout selection, selection data flow, or playback control into separate components.

issue__mode_tab_responsive_regression.description: Tiny viewport widths can make mode/workspace tab transitions inconsistent or visually inert across model view modes, while continuity assertions still pass with relaxed layout expectations.
issue__mode_tab_responsive_regression.current_solution: Toolbar mode tabs now occupy a full-width scrollable row under 800px; layout buttons are disabled until a model exists and `App` forces no-model layout back to single. `smoke.spec.ts` includes a 360px post-load mode cycle that clicks Model/Rig/Skin/Animate/Export without forced clicks and verifies selected-bone plus scrub continuity.
issue__mode_tab_responsive_regression.next_prevention: Keep constrained-width mode coverage whenever toolbar layout, mode state, or panel mount behavior changes.

issue__export_inflight_guard.description: Rapid repeated export actions can overlap async save/write operations and leave duplicate writes or stale status/UI state when users interact faster than completion.
issue__export_inflight_guard.status: completed 2026-06-18: in-flight save/write is hardened with `isExportingRef` + export sequence guard; UI stays busy until completion and stale completions are ignored.
issue__export_inflight_guard.current_solution: Export handlers call a shared `withExportBusy` wrapper that serializes export calls, uses a per-export sequence token to ignore stale completions, and reuses `ui.isLoading` for toolbar/mode/layout lockout. IPC mock supports `writeDelayMs` and native e2e asserts one write only under rapid clicks.
issue__export_inflight_guard.next_prevention: Keep native delayed-write single-flight coverage while export/state transitions evolve.
